canada.title: Woman's airport security ordeal with dad's ashes highlights challenges of travelling with cremated remains

lines: Good morning. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Zelensky says Putin is a ‘killer’ after Trump calls Russian leader a friend, BBC News reports.

In a lengthy press conference, President Trump touted his recent trip to Asia and defended his relationship with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin, PBS NewsHour reports.

Mexican authorities captured top cartel boss Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as “El Chapo Isidro,” in the Mexican state of Sinaloa overnight, resulting in a burst of violence that rattled civilians, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
